state.user_query: Please set up an audit mechanism. Find all encounters for very risky patients and log their key information into it. Make sure to include a timestamp and note the reason.

dialogue_history.content: Should “very risky” use the High-Risk Patient definition (suicide risk High/Severe, PHQ-9 > 15, or GAD-7 > 15), or a different threshold?

The “very risky patients” group is defined as patients with suicide risk rated High or Severe, combined with either a PHQ-9 depression score greater than 19 or a GAD-7 anxiety score greater than 14. So the thresholds are PHQ-9 > 19 and GAD-7 > 14, not > 15.
What should the audit mechanism be named, which key fields and reason should it store, and is this a one-time log or should future encounters be logged automatically?

The audit mechanism should be named `high_risk_encounter_audit`. It should store the following key fields: `audit_id` (auto-generated primary key), `enckey` (encounter key), `patkey` (patient key), `clinid` (clinician ID), `facid` (facility ID), `audit_timestamp` (defaulting to the current timestamp), and `reason` (recording 'High Severity and High Suicide Risk'). This is designed as a log table that captures snapshots of qualifying encounters at the time of insertion; it does not automatically log future encounters on its own—new qualifying encounters would be captured when the insert operation is run again.
Should qualification be based on each encounter’s linked assessment (encounters.abref), or should every encounter of a patient be logged if any assessment for that patient meets the risk criteria?

The qualification is based on each encounter’s linked assessment via `encounters.abref` joined to `assessmentsymptomsandrisk.asrkey`. Only encounters whose own linked assessment meets the risk criteria are logged; it is not expanded to all encounters for a patient based on any other assessment.

CREATE TABLE high_risk_encounter_audit (
    audit_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    enckey VARCHAR,
    patkey VARCHAR,
    clinid VARCHAR,
    facid VARCHAR,
    audit_timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    reason TEXT
);

INSERT INTO high_risk_encounter_audit (enckey, patkey, clinid, facid, reason)
SELECT e.enckey, e.patref, e.clinid, e.facid,
       'High Severity and High Suicide Risk'
FROM encounters AS e
JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS r ON r.asrkey = e.abref
WHERE r.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')
  AND ((r.mental_health_scores #>> '{depression,phq9_score}')::numeric > 19
       OR (r.mental_health_scores #>> '{anxiety,gad7_score}')::numeric > 14);
